title: Who sees the sea? Sea-view potential by fa\c{c}ade and floor from cadastral LoD1 models on the Costa del Sol
abstract: arXiv:2611.21672v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Views are among the most valued and least measured attributes of a home. We present an open-data method that estimates the sea-view potential of every free fa\c{c}ade of every residential building at three floors (ground, middle and top; other floors take the nearest of them), from cadastral footprints with floor counts and a national terrain model. Run for 158,060 buildings of 21 municipalities on Spain's Costa del Sol in under an hour on two cores, it finds that 52 % of buildings see some sea from their top floor and 36 % have an open view (20{\deg} or more). Traced over a LiDAR surface in a pilot, scores agree with the model's inside cadastral footprints (96.7 % of viewpoints in the same class at 20{\deg}), but structures the cadastre does not record lower the sea seen from the top floor by 6.1--9.0{\deg} on average. translated_title: 谁能看到海？基于地籍LoD1模型按立面与楼层评估太阳海岸的海景潜力
translated_abstract: 视野是住宅最受重视却最少被测量的属性之一。我们提出了一种开放数据方法，仅利用带楼层数的地籍轮廓图和国家地形模型，即可估算每栋住宅建筑每个无遮挡立面在三个楼层（底层、中层和顶层，其余楼层取其最邻近层）的海景潜力。该方法在双核处理器上不到一小时内完成了西班牙太阳海岸21个市镇共158,060栋建筑的运算，发现52%的建筑从顶层可见部分海景，36%的建筑拥有开阔视野（20°或以上）。在一项基于LiDAR表面的试点追踪中，评分与地籍轮廓内的模型结果高度一致（在20°阈值下96.7%的观测点落入同一类别），但地籍未记录的构筑物平均会使顶层可见海景减少6.1–9.0°。在与93套在售住宅照片（由两家开发商的AI模型进行盲标注，判定关系由作者……）的对比中……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于开放地籍LoD1数据的快速海景潜力评估方法，可按建筑立面与楼层量化每栋住宅的海景可见度，并在西班牙太阳海岸15.8万余栋建筑上以不到一小时的双核运算验证了其高效性，结果与LiDAR追踪和房源照片高度一致。
en_tdlr: The paper presents an open-data method that estimates per-façade and per-floor sea-view potential from cadastral LoD1 footprints and a national terrain model, efficiently scoring 158,060 buildings across Spain's Costa del Sol in under an hour with strong agreement against LiDAR traces and listing photos.
